newsitem.title: UK: Chugoku Electric eyes dollar, mark bonds.
newsitem.headline: Chugoku Electric eyes dollar, mark bonds.

text.p: Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc could launch both mark and dollar Eurobonds in the next two weeks, syndicate managers said on Tuesday.
A 250-300 million mark seven-year bond via Commerzbank was being considered, as well as a $200 million five-year issue.
"Chugoku is looking at mark and dollar Eurobonds, but also at the domestic yen market," a syndicate manager at a European bank said.
"We are expecting a mark deal this week and a dollar issue next week, but their plans could still change," he said.
Spread talk on the mark transaction was 28-30 basis points over government bonds, dealers said.
The dollar issue, for which IBJ International was tipped as lead manager, was mooted at around 25 b.p. over U.S. Treasuries.
